title: Three-term recurrence for Krawtchouk polynomials
statement:
Let $n$, $j$, and $x$ be natural numbers with $1 \le j$, $j + 1 \le n$, and $x \le n$. Then the binary Krawtchouk polynomials $K_j^{(n)}$ satisfy the three-term recurrence
\[
  (j+1)\,K_{j+1}^{(n)}(x) \;=\; (n - 2x)\,K_j^{(n)}(x) \;-\; (n - j + 1)\,K_{j-1}^{(n)}(x).
\]
